events.title: Introducing BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
events.summary: Salute to all Voyagers! 🫡We’re excited to introduce our upcoming title, BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS! 🐾🔫BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.
